metadata.description: Build your own fleet of always-on Claude Code agents — stateful, proactive, customizable, and operator-controlled.

plugins.name: claude-code-hermit
plugins.description: An always-on Claude Code agent. Stateful. Proactive. Self-improving through an operator-gated proposal system. Cost-aware. Observable.

plugins.name: claude-code-dev-hermit
plugins.description: A development layer for claude-code-hermit. Enforces git safety across every coding agent and adds optional test, quality, debugging, conflict-resolution, and PR workflows.

plugins.name: claude-code-homeassistant-hermit
plugins.description: A Home Assistant development and operations agent built on claude-code-hermit. Build, manage, monitor, and troubleshoot everything from automations and dashboards to helpers, devices, backups, and energy — with operator-controlled safety.

plugins.name: claude-code-fitness-hermit
plugins.description: A read-only Strava training agent built on claude-code-hermit. Analyzes activities, tracks load and RPE, flags recovery risks, and runs routines shaped around your training week.

plugins.name: feed-hermit
plugins.description: A feed-to-brief agent built on claude-code-hermit. Choose the sources, priorities, voice, and schedule; it delivers briefs, tracks developing stories, and audits source quality.

plugins.name: laravel-forge-hermit
plugins.description: A Laravel Forge operations agent built on claude-code-hermit. Deploy, manage, monitor, and troubleshoot your estate through the official Forge SDK — from daily health checks to operator-gated deployment workflows.

plugins.name: hermit-scribe
plugins.description: A GitHub App Bot for claude-code-hermit maintainers. Turns proposals and ad-hoc reports into privacy-scrubbed, deduplicated GitHub issues, with operator approval before publishing.
